body.name: OmegaC
body.def: \(\Omega_{n,C}(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)\) contains exactly the histories \(((H'_{n,s},z'_{n1s})_{s\in S},(z'_{n2s})_{s:C_s=1})\) such that \((H'_{n,s},z'_{n1s})\in\Omega_{n,1s}(\rho)\), \(C'_n(\rho)=C_n(\rho)=C\), and \(z'_{n2s}\in\{0,1\}^{N_{n2s}}\) with \(\sum_i z'_{n2si}=m_{n2s}\) for every retained stratum \(s\) satisfying \(C_s=1\). There is no stage-2 coordinate when \(C_s=0\).
